_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Mobilization Plan
summary: The Mobilization Plan details the contractor's proposed organization, responsibility, and procedures for mobilizing the system and serves as the principal means of planning and executing mobilization operations.
use_relationship:
The Mobilization Plan details the contractor's proposed organization, responsibility, and procedures for mobilization of the system and serves as the principal means of planning and executing mobilization operations.
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirements as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Mobilization Plan shall be in contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The plan shall contain a title page specifying the following: a. Title/identification of the system/component/program/project. b. Title of Document. c. Contract number. d. Preparing activity or contractor's title. e. Security classification, when required. f. Distribution statement. g. Date of generated document.

children.title: The plan shall identify procedures and requirements (if applicable) for the following:
Preliminary preparations for mobilization and demobilization (to include licensing, permits, site visits, etc.)
Detailed procedures for the transportation and loading of systems and materials onto vessel of opportunity (VOO) and elapsed times.
Manpower, personnel, and tools requirements for all mobilization efforts.
Detailed procedures for installation of systems onto the VOO and elapsed times.
Detailed procedures for off-loading of systems and materials from the VOO and elapsed times.
Paperwork:
children.content: Describe the procedures of handling and use of records, files, listings, and other documentation related to the mobilization operations.
